# Naga Industries

> Philippine laptop and AI mini PC brand. SIPAG I productivity laptop, LAKAN II gaming laptop and DIWA AI mini PC, which runs Baku, Naga's own local AI. Ships from Manila by DHL Express.

Facts below match the website. Product names (SIPAG, LAKAN, DIWA, Baku) and the motto Sulong ("forward") are Filipino words.

## Products

- [LAKAN II gaming laptop: RTX 5060 at 115W, Core 7 250H](https://naga.industries/lakan-ii.html): gaming laptop. Intel Core 7 250H, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU at up to 115W, 16GB DDR5-5600, 512GB PCIe Gen4 SSD, 15.6-inch display. ₱89,900 (about US$1,430), Naga Karga backpack included. Pre-order.
- [SIPAG I productivity laptop: 1.30 kg, up to 13 hours](https://naga.industries/sipag-i.html): productivity laptop. Intel Core Ultra 5 125U, 14-inch Full HD, 60Wh battery for up to 13 hours, 1.30 kg, USB-C charging. Price to be confirmed. Pre-order.
- [DIWA AI mini PC with Baku, a private local AI](https://naga.industries/diwa.html): AI mini PC that runs Baku, Naga's own local AI. Coming soon, no price yet; reservations are open.

## Baku

- Baku is Naga's own AI. It runs on DIWA itself, keeps data on the machine, works offline and speaks every language. It is being built with the Machine.Fun ecosystem: https://machine.fun/project/J8RKZwmr8ol

## Buying and shipping

- Shipping: free in the Philippines; US$100 flat rate worldwide by DHL Express from Manila, 3 to 14 days by zone.
- Contact: hello@nagatech.ph
